m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Oh, hey there, Wizard. Been seeing a lot of you lately. What's that? My Sheriff tried to sell the Cretan Bull to the Nimbari?
Well, I'll summon him at once. *clears throat* POOOOOOIIIIIIIIRRRRRRROOOOOOTTTTTT!!!!!!
You're fired. Also under arrest for violating our treaty with the Cretan Bull. Now get yourself to jail before I drag you there by the nose.
Thanks for the help there, Wizard. And don't worry, I'll make things up with the Cretan Bull. We'll set this right.
Helpful Reminder: Have you talked with Sheriff Poirot, Wizard? Okay or cancel?
